name: sutd-bge-large-aug98
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Fine-tune of BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (335M, 1024-dim, MultipleNegativesRankingLoss, lr 2e-5, effective batch 16, early-stopped at epoch 3 of 10) for job-description-to-SUTD-module retrieval. Trained on 98 pairs - 67 hand-annotated plus 31 LLM-labelled - which expands to 831 training samples after hard-negative mining, and is evaluated on a TEN-QUERY held-out set. The card is honest that this is a course-project production model, and the single recorded row should be read with that in mind: 0.679 -> 0.770 NDCG@10 on ten queries is one or two queries deciding the result. Its own sibling ft67 (0.747) is a 67-pair model, so the 31 augmented pairs are worth roughly two points here. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-25.

benchmarks.name: NDCG@10 (SUTD 10-job held-out retrieval)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | NDCG@10 |': 'BGE-large-en-v1.5 (base)' 0.679, 'sutd-bge-large-ft67' 0.747, 'sutd-bge-large-aug98 (this model)' 0.770. Evaluated on a 10-job held-out retrieval set for job-description-to-SUTD-module search - a tiny private task, not a public benchmark. Trained on 98 pairs (67 hand-annotated + 31 Claude-labelled), 831 training samples after hard-negative expansion, converged at epoch 3. x100.
